I also got a $30 REWARDS card. Wow, what’s going on? Just got my second order within a week with 5% credit and $10 off. I'm going to take a day off of working from home. That's pretty fucking cool. I just got orders for The 1 year Prime The 3 months of Amazon music 2 for $40 Fire tablets + ref 10.1 $40 ref 5. $130. Good stuff I have also signed up and I'm waiting in line to start my 3 months of amazon music. Any word on when we'll get confirmation about the free shipping? I actually ended up waiting 10 minutes or less... Damn! I'm gonna have to try this now...We all know how popular Amazon Instant Video is and we know how it's limited to 1080p when on is 5x more expensive than the 4K one. There are videos released on Instant Video before they're released on 4K Ultra HD and Amazon. So it makes no sense to spend £35 on a movie to only get it in 1080p when it's available on 4K for £25 (sorry EU prices this was at US prices in December). I can't see any benefit in this, not only to me but also that I expect these companies will lose quite Alot of money if we don't re-buy the movie again.
